build_system: npm with Next.js build, deployed on Vercel
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to ensure no TypeScript errors and the app compiles successfully
environment_constraints: Supabase for DB, Resend for email. Build must pass with npm run build.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns in the codebase. Use service-role dbAdmin() for admin API routes. Use requireAdmin() guard on all admin endpoints.
key_patterns: Admin APIs at app/api/admin/* use requireAdmin() + dbAdmin(). Admin page is client-side fetching /api/admin. fulfillChallenge() in lib/fulfillment.ts is called by both payment webhooks. Email notifications use lib/email.ts with Resend. Plans/rules defined in lib/plans.ts.
directory_structure: app/ = Next.js App Router pages + API routes. lib/ = shared business logic. supabase/ = schema SQL. app/admin/ = admin panel pages. app/api/admin/ = admin API routes.
